habitat.en: Lakes and medium to large rivers.
habitat.fr: Lacs et rivières moyennes à grandes.

diet.en: It eats fish, insects, shrimp, snails, seeds and fruit.
diet.fr: Il mange poissons, insectes, crevettes, escargots, graines et fruits.

behavior.en: Adults shoal; activity peaks at night.
behavior.fr: Les adultes vivent en bancs et sont surtout actifs la nuit.

reproduction.en: It spawns in rainy seasons; eggs are laid on plants.
reproduction.fr: Il pond pendant les saisons des pluies, sur la végétation.

ecology.en: It is potamodromous; spawning migrations are reported.
ecology.fr: Il est potamodrome ; des migrations de reproduction sont signalées.

facts: FishBase describes its African range, freshwater habitats, maximum size, varied diet, shoaling and dim-light activity, rainy-season spawning and Least Concern assessment in 2019.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Meristic characters and biology of Schilbe mystus in Côte d’Ivoire — IRD
title.fr: Caractères méristiques et biologie de Schilbe mystus en Côte d’Ivoire — IRD

facts: This French-language study documents S. mystus in several Ivorian basins and describes its wider African distribution, allowing comparison with FishBase’s more cautious range notes.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Older reports of the species outside its better-supported Nilo-Sudanese and western African range may include misidentifications; FishBase flags several such records as uncertain.
